title: Duality exact sequences for a reduced closed subscheme of a Gorenstein curve and its scheme-theoretic complement
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file curves.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma is the duality bookkeeping engine for decomposing a Gorenstein curve into a closed subscheme and its complement (statement lines 1011-1049 with six exact sequences). The proof (lines 1051-1112) assembles: the CM fact and the union sequence, a diagram chase identifying the ideal sheaves with their pushed-forward restrictions, the relations I + J and I  cap  J giving six sequences, the reduction by symmetry to one duality statement, and the annihilator identification via SheafHom and evaluation at 1. H3: the sequence bookkeeping and the two-step reduction to the annihilator statement are a genuine argument.
